entities.name: Mihailo Petrović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mihailo Petrović Alas, was a Serbian mathematician, inventor, university professor and academic. He was a distinguished professor at Belgrade University, an academic, philosopher, writer, publicist, musician, businessman, traveler and volunteer in the Balkan Wars, the First and Second World Wars and licenced fisherman by trade.
